'''Resurrect Crops''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires a [[Magic]] level of 78 to cast. This spell gives the caster a chance to bring a dead [[Farming patch]] back to life (excluding the [[anima patch]], [[Hespori]], and [[Tithe Farm]]). The chance of the spell succeeding is dependent on a player's Magic level, with a 50% chance at 78 Magic, scaling to a 75% chance at 99 Magic.{{CiteNews|author=The Old School Team|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/necromancy-improvements?oldschool=1|title=Necromancy Improvements|newsdate=28 January 2016|quote=The chance of the spell succeeding is dependent on your Magic level, starting with a 50% chance at 78 Magic and scaling up to a 75% chance at 99 Magic.}} Visible [[Temporary skill boost|boosts]] to the player's Magic level will increase the chance of a successful resurrection, but note that boosts beyond level 99 have no impact on the [[Skilling success rate|skilling success function]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1470793534148157443|date=14 December 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108063|archivedate=13 April 2023|quote=It rolls on your Magic stat, so visible boosts to that will help. It doesn't appear to involve your Farming stat.}}

If cast successfully, the patch will return to life and resume growing. If the spell fails, the patch is automatically cleared. Note that if a resurrected patch dies once more, this spell will not work again; attempting to do so will result in a message in the chatbox stating {{Mes|You already resurrected these crops once. Clear the patch and start again.}}.

The spell is relatively expensive to cast, so it is not recommended to use it on cheap seeds. It can be used to help reduce the cost of training [[farming]] with higher level [[tree seed]]s when not paying a nearby [[Group of Advanced Gardeners|gardener]] for protection.
